openai_sxs_tour.title: 01 · Roth IRA Growth Calculator — Official OpenAI CDN vs A2UI Lumina
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Welcome to the OpenAI Intelligent UI and A2UI Lumina side-by-side showcase. On the left runs OpenAI's official standalone HTML bundle; on the right is a pure declarative A2UI v1.0 surface with zero custom JavaScript. Watch both Roth IRA calculators start at four hundred sixteen thousand one hundred twenty-nine dollars, then recompute identically in zero milliseconds as we raise monthly contributions to six hundred dollars and annual return to eight percent.

openai_sxs_tour.title: 02 · The Dinner Ledger — Tactile Clipboard Party-of-Five Splitter
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Next, OpenAI's Dinner Ledger clipboard for a party of five. Lumina's new SplitLedger component matches the warm archival paper, metal clip, editable guest roster, and shared House Red bottle totaling one hundred seven dollars and seventy-eight cents. Selecting a twenty percent tip and clicking Split the Check on both sides produces cent-exact largest-remainder receipts.

openai_sxs_tour.title: 03 · Pixel Palace Retro Arcade & Drum Lab 01
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Third, OpenAI's Pixel Palace 1989 handheld console and Drum Lab sequencer. Lumina's MicroApp component runs playable sixty frames-per-second Snake, Breakout, and Pong on matching dot-matrix L C D screens, and switches cleanly to a sixteen-step synthesized WebAudio groovebox—while isolating any custom HTML inside a locked-down script-only sandbox.

openai_sxs_tour.title: 04 · How a 7-Speed Bicycle Works — Subsystem Schematic
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Fourth, the interactive seven-speed commuter bicycle schematic. AnnotatedDiagram pairs spring-animated subsystem filter pills and numbered hotspot callouts with an animated drivetrain chain. Filtering to Drivetrain and shifting from Gear four up to sprint Gear seven updates mechanical advantage and road speed live on both sides.

openai_sxs_tour.title: 05 · San Francisco in One Day — Cartographic RouteMap & Dark Mode
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Fifth, San Francisco in One Day combines a three-photo landmark strip and grounded Fleet Week citation with Lumina's cartographic RouteMap. Clicking numbered stops from the Ferry Building to Crissy Field reveals detour notes, and toggling Dark Mode shifts water, parks, and street geometry across both surfaces simultaneously.

openai_sxs_tour.title: 06 · Mediterranean Sunday Lamb Roast — Guest Scaler & Cooking Checklist
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Sixth, the Mediterranean Sunday Lamb Roast. Incrementing total guests from six to eight immediately scales bone-in lamb shoulder, lemon-oregano potatoes, feta, and pita through client-side computeMath bindings, while ChecklistCard tracks each timed prep step with strikethrough motion and a live emerald progress bar.

openai_sxs_tour.title: 07 · Functional Dog Vest Moodboard — Gallery Cards & SwatchPicker
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Seventh, the Dog Vest Moodboard. ChoicePicker's new gallery mode renders portrait concept cards with emerald selection badges. Switching from Trail Utility to Urban Minimal updates material headlines declaratively via selectByValue, while SwatchPicker selects tactile colorways with luminance-aware contrast checkmarks.

openai_sxs_tour.title: 08 · GDP Identity, Central Limit Theorem & Quiz + Live A2UI Wire JSON
openai_sxs_tour.speech: Finally, interactive STEM learning and comprehension checks. Dragging Net Exports negative surfaces a trade-deficit note, clicking Draw one hundred samples runs client-side Monte Carlo Central Limit Theorem convergence into a bell-curve Chart, and QuizCard verifies comprehension with instant emerald feedback—all driven by compact, schema-validated A2UI v1.0 JSON.
